survivingClaim: No statement about zeros of zeta. (a) Relative to joint and hybrid universality as printed in Matsumoto's survey (statements checked against the PDF; primary texts not opened): a sup-norm-closed, height-independent condition on a fixed compact window with connected complement in 1/2 < Re s < 1 for finitely many pairwise non-equivalent Dirichlet L-functions that holds outside a set of heights of upper density zero contains every non-vanishing analytic tuple; a continuous inequality in finitely many values and derivatives at fixed offsets then holds on the whole jet space. Class-N conditions are automatic on zero-free windows only. These are classical consequences (Voronin functional independence, Kaczorowski-Kulas), used as a filter; device reading 1 restated (7), 4 in part, 2 restated, 27 out of scope is ARGUED. Not checkable numerically at accessible heights. (b) For K_F = {v >= 0, Fv >= 0}: its linear functionals are the entrywise ones at x and 1/x (proved); at q = 5 the F-fixed extreme rays give zeta(s)(1 + 5^(1/2-s)) +- L(s, chi_5), with at least CT zeros in every sub-strip relative to Nakamura-Pankowski and measured zeros off the line (0.7796 + 61.1685i and others, reproduced and extended to height 200); the T-NR lift has every input of candidate (CW), with zeros at Re s = 1/2 +- arccosh(c/2)/log p_0 (inside the strip only for 2 < c < 2.1213 at p_0 = 2). Candidate (CW) is closed; other F-adapted cones are not covered.
obstruction: (a) Relative to joint/hybrid universality (Matsumoto survey statements): a sup-norm-closed height-independent condition on a fixed window in 1/2 < Re s < 1 for finitely many Dirichlet L-functions that holds off a density-zero set of heights contains every non-vanishing analytic tuple; so such a condition is empty, a zero statement in the same window, or false on positive density. Narrow filter (27 of 34 devices out of scope), not numerically checkable. (b) Cone K_F = {v >= 0, Fv >= 0}: linear functionals are entrywise at x and 1/x; at q = 5 the F-fixed extreme rays give zeta(s)(1 + 5^(1/2-s)) +- L(s,chi_5) with off-line zeros. Candidate (CW) closed; other F-adapted cones not covered.

lesson: A height-uniform local inequality on L-values in the open strip carries no arithmetic: it is empty, a zero statement in the same window, or false on a positive density of heights. This filter is narrow, because most devices read the completed function, kernels or coefficients, and its verdicts cannot be cross-checked at computable heights. In cone language, "automorphism at every prime" and "kernel with polar terms non-negative" separate T-NR and E_a only as inputs; no inequality over a cone consumes the first, since cone inequalities are preserved by every cone endomorphism.
